notes: In progress. Read the Archdiocese parish finder (archphila.org redirects to catholicchurchofphila.org, then /parish/ and the Philadelphia-North and Philadelphia-South vicariate pages, all pages). Parishes with a closing year in the Archdiocese title (for example 1902 to 2012) are treated as closed and not recorded, except St. Rita of Cascia Shrine and Mater Dolorosa, which were checked directly. Parishes A through D and St. Bridget, St. Gabriel and St. Paul were left to the other agent per the slice. Outside the city, not recorded: St. Joseph (Cheltenham) and Presentation B.V.M. (Cheltenham), both on the North list. Parish pages say 'last updated N months ago' with no date, so those are not treated as dated evidence; status is probably_active where the Mass schedule is current. Only the Archdiocese parish pages were read, not each parish's own website. Community programs (pantries, meals, St. Vincent de Paul conferences, senior and young adult groups) were not shown on most parish pages.
